description: List the times a Booking Agent has open for appointments, earliest first, with readable times in the organizer's timezone. They're the times its join page offers: its weekly hours, date range, minimum notice, buffer, places per time, existing bookings and busy times on the organizer's checked calendar. Pass a time's startsAt as starts_at to book_appointment or reschedule_booking. from and to are dates in the Booking Agent's timezone; leave them out for the next two weeks, and keep them within 90 days.

from.description: The first day to list, like 2026-11-05, in the Booking Agent's timezone. Defaults to today.

limit.description: How many times to return, up to 100. Defaults to 50.

timezone.description: IANA timezone for the readable times in the result, like America/Chicago. Defaults to the organizer's timezone.

to.description: The last day to list, like 2026-11-18. Defaults to two weeks from from, and can be at most 89 days after it.

name: list_open_times

bookingAgentTimezone.description: The timezone from and to are read in.

placesLeft.description: How many more people can book this time.

startsAt.description: Pass as starts_at to book_appointment or reschedule_booking.

truncated.description: True when there were more open times than limit. Narrow from and to to see the later ones.

title: List open appointment times
